name: hcapp_syncKennelAdminData
description: Incremental pull-sync for kennel-level admin data. Each of the five entity types is gated by a watermark parameter — 'ignore' (default) skips that table. HasherKennelMap is scoped to @kennelId; Payments and HasherEventMap are scoped to @targetHasherId if provided. Used after write SPs that modify kennel-level membership so the admin view is immediately updated. Supports the write-SP delegation pattern via @procName and @param.

parameters.name: deviceId
parameters.description: Registered device UUID. Passed to ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: accessToken
parameters.description: Short-lived cryptographic token. Validated against the delegating context (@param) or DeviceSecret by ValidateAppAuth.

parameters.name: kennelId
parameters.description: Kennel to scope the sync to. Required — returns errorCode 1272 if NULL or zero UUID.

parameters.name: hashersUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Hasher (global, not kennel-scoped). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Hashers rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: kennelsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Kennel (global). 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Kennels rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.HasherKennelMap scoped to @kennelId. 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the HasherKennelMap rowset. Default 'ignore'.

parameters.name: hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.HasherEventMap scoped to @targetHasherId. 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the HasherEventMap rowset.

parameters.name: paymentsUpdatedAfter
parameters.description: Watermark for HC.Payment scoped to @targetHasherId. 'ignore' or NULL or <= '2000-01-01' skips the Payments rowset.

parameters.name: targetHasherId
parameters.description: When provided, scopes the Payments and HasherEventMap rowsets to this specific hasher. Payments filter uses UserId = @targetHasherId with no kennelId constraint.

parameters.name: usePaging
parameters.description: Default 0 (unlimited). When 1, limits Kennels and HasherKennelMap to 250 rows; Hashers to 1000 rows. HasherEventMap has no page limit even when paging is enabled.

parameters.name: procName
parameters.description: Delegating SP name for write-SP delegation pattern. NULL = direct call. Used as the effective proc name in ValidateAppAuth and error logs.

parameters.name: param
parameters.description: Delegating SP token suffix for write-SP delegation pattern. NULL = DeviceSecret only.

rowsets.name: Error
rowsets.description: Returned on auth failure (errorType=11 from ValidateAppAuth) or missing kennelId (errorType=12, errorCode=1272). Mutually exclusive with all data rowsets.

columns.name: errorId
columns.description: Unique ID of the HC.ErrorLog entry.

columns.name: errorType
columns.description: Error classification. 12=validation (missing kennelId); see ValidateAppAuth for auth error codes.

columns.name: errorCode
columns.description: Specific error code. 1272 = null or zero-UUID kennelId.

columns.name: errorProc
columns.description: Effective SP name (delegating SP name if called via delegation, otherwise OBJECT_NAME(@@PROCID)).

rowsets.name: Kennels
rowsets.description: Emitted when @kennelsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. All kennels updated after the watermark (global, not scoped to @kennelId). Ordered by updatedAt ASC, id ASC. Page limit: 250 rows when @usePaging=1.

columns.name: kennelMismanagementTeam
columns.description: Mis-management team description. COALESCE to '' so never null.

columns.name: defaultEventCurrencyType
columns.description: Default currency type code for events.

columns.name: allowNegativeCredit
columns.description: Whether negative hash credit is permitted.

columns.name: canEditRunAttendence
columns.description: Whether attendees can edit their own attendance.

columns.name: kennelLatitude
columns.description: Kennel.Latitude coalesced with City.Latitude. Falls back to city coords when kennel has no lat.

columns.name: kennelLongitude
columns.description: Kennel.Longitude coalesced with City.Longitude. Falls back to city coords when kennel has no lon.

columns.name: defaultRunStartTime
columns.description: Default run start time of day.

columns.name: runCountStartDate
columns.description: Date from which run counts are calculated.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Local DATETIME2 string (CONVERT from DATETIMEOFFSET). Used as next sync watermark.

rowsets.name: HasherKennelMap
rowsets.description: Emitted when @hasherKennelMapUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. HKM records for @kennelId updated after the watermark. isMember is computed dynamically from MembershipExpirationDate > GETDATE() (breaking change vs HC5 which returned the stored IsMember column). Ordered by updatedAt ASC, id ASC. Page limit: 250 rows when @usePaging=1.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: The hasher this map entry belongs to.

columns.name: kennelId
columns.description: The kennel this map entry belongs to.

columns.name: following
columns.description: Whether the hasher is following this kennel.

columns.name: isMember
columns.description: Computed: 1 if MembershipExpirationDate > GETDATE(), else 0. Breaking change: HC5 returned the stored IsMember column, which could be stale.

columns.name: isHomeKennel
columns.description: Whether this is the hasher's home kennel.

columns.name: isKennelFollowing
columns.description: Whether the hasher is in the kennel following list.

columns.name: kennelNotificationPreference
columns.description: Push notification preference for this kennel.

columns.name: kennelEmailAlertPreference
columns.description: Email alert preference for this kennel.

columns.name: discountAmount
columns.description: Fixed discount amount applied to this hasher.

columns.name: discountPercent
columns.description: Percentage discount applied to this hasher.

columns.name: hcTotalRunCount
columns.description: Total run count tracked by Harrier Central.

columns.name: hcHaringCount
columns.description: Total haring count tracked by Harrier Central.

columns.name: membershipExpirationDate
columns.description: Date membership expires. NULL = no membership.

columns.name: dateOfLastRun
columns.description: Date of the hasher's last recorded run at this kennel.

columns.name: authorizedDeviceList
columns.description: Always returns empty string ''. Device list is not returned by this SP.

columns.name: authorizedDeviceCount
columns.description: Always returns 0. Device count is not returned by this SP.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Local DATETIME2 string (CONVERT from DATETIMEOFFSET). Used as next sync watermark.

rowsets.name: Hashers
rowsets.description: Emitted when @hashersUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. All hashers updated after the watermark (global, not kennel-scoped). Ordered by updatedAt ASC, id ASC. Page limit: 1000 rows when @usePaging=1.

columns.name: dispName
columns.description: Computed display name (persisted column). COALESCE to ''.

columns.name: dispPref
columns.description: Display name preference (0=real name, 1=hash name). COALESCE to 0.

columns.name: includeInGlobalHashDirectory
columns.description: Whether the hasher appears in the global directory. COALESCE to 0.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Local DATETIME2 string (CONVERT from DATETIMEOFFSET). COALESCE(updatedAt, GETDATE()) before conversion. Used as next sync watermark.

rowsets.name: Payments
rowsets.description: Emitted when @paymentsUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. Payments where UserId = @targetHasherId and updatedAt > watermark. No ORDER BY clause — returned in storage order. No page limit regardless of @usePaging.

columns.name: kennelId
columns.description: Kennel the payment belongs to. Note: not filtered by @kennelId — may include payments from other kennels.

columns.name: creditAvailable
columns.description: Available credit at time of payment.

columns.name: paidDate
columns.description: Payment date cast to DATETIME (loses timezone). Source column is DATETIMEOFFSET(7).

columns.name: paymentType
columns.description: Payment type code (0=Unknown, 1=Not paid, 2=Free, 3=Cash, 4=Bank Transfer, etc.).

columns.name: cancelledDate
columns.description: Cancellation date cast to DATETIME (loses timezone). Source column is DATETIMEOFFSET(7).

columns.name: confirmedDate
columns.description: Confirmation date cast to DATETIME (loses timezone). Source column is DATETIMEOFFSET(7).

columns.name: specialRunPriceReason
columns.description: Reason for a special run price.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Local DATETIME2 string (CONVERT from DATETIMEOFFSET). Used as next sync watermark.

rowsets.name: HasherEventMap
rowsets.description: Emitted when @hasherEventMapUpdatedAfter != 'ignore'. HEM records where UserId = @targetHasherId and updatedAt > watermark. Joined to HC.Event for denormalised event fields, and to HC.HasherKennelMap for kennel-specific photo and hash name. Ordered by updatedAt ASC, id ASC. No page limit regardless of @usePaging.

columns.name: hemId
columns.description: Primary key of the HEM record.

columns.name: userId
columns.description: The hasher this HEM record belongs to.

columns.name: eventId
columns.description: The event this HEM record belongs to.

columns.name: isHare
columns.description: Whether the hasher was a hare for this event.

columns.name: totalHaring
columns.description: Cumulative haring count at time of this event.

columns.name: totalHaringThisKennel
columns.description: Haring count for this kennel at time of this event.

columns.name: totalRuns
columns.description: Cumulative run count at time of this event.

columns.name: totalRunsThisKennel
columns.description: Run count for this kennel at time of this event.

columns.name: displayName
columns.description: Display name override recorded at time of event.

columns.name: email
columns.description: Email recorded at time of event.

columns.name: phoneNumber
columns.description: Phone number recorded at time of event.

columns.name: hemEventNumber
columns.description: Run number of the associated event.

columns.name: hemEventName
columns.description: Event name: uses FbEventName when UseFbRunDetails=1, otherwise EventName.

columns.name: hemEventStartDatetime
columns.description: Event start datetime as DATETIME2: uses FbEventStartDatetime when UseFbRunDetails=1, otherwise EventStartDatetime.

columns.name: hemEventStartDatetimeGmt
columns.description: Event start datetime (GMT) as DATETIME2: uses FbEventStartDatetime when UseFbRunDetails=1, otherwise EventStartDatetimeGmt. Note: second derivation uses Fb column for both local and GMT when UseFbRunDetails=1 — EventStartDatetimeGmt is not used in the FB branch.

columns.name: eventStartDatetimeGmt
columns.description: COALESCE(Event.EventStartDatetimeGmt, Event.EventStartDatetime). Raw DATETIMEOFFSET, not cast to DATETIME2. Duplicate of hemEventStartDatetimeGmt with different derivation.

columns.name: hemCanEditRunAttendence
columns.description: Whether attendees can edit attendance for this event.

columns.name: hemEventIsCountedAndVisible
columns.description: Computed: 1 if Event.IsCountedRun != 0 AND Event.IsVisible != 0, else 0.

columns.name: hemKennelUserPhoto
columns.description: Hasher's kennel-specific profile photo. From left-joined HKM row matched on UserId and KennelId from HEM.

columns.name: hemKennelHashName
columns.description: Hasher's kennel-specific hash name. From left-joined HKM row.

columns.name: updatedAt
columns.description: Local DATETIME2 string (CONVERT from DATETIMEOFFSET). Used as next sync watermark.

codeSmells.detail: The Payments rowset filters only on pmt.UserId = @targetHasherId with no kennelId restriction (line 291). A call for kennel A can return payments the hasher made at kennels B and C. This may be intentional for a full hasher payment view, but it deviates from the kennel-scoped intent of the SP and should be documented for callers.

The HasherEventMap rowset (lines 297-338) has no FETCH NEXT clause. When @usePaging=1, Kennels, HasherKennelMap, and Hashers are page-limited but HEM is not. A hasher with many events could return an unbounded result set.

codeSmells.issue: Payments has no ORDER BY and no page limit
codeSmells.detail: The Payments rowset (lines 259-292) has no ORDER BY clause and no FETCH NEXT clause. Row order is non-deterministic and the result set is unbounded regardless of @usePaging.

codeSmells.issue: Duplicate eventStartDatetimeGmt columns with different derivations
codeSmells.detail: The HasherEventMap rowset returns two GMT datetime columns: hemEventStartDatetimeGmt (lines 323-324, cast to DATETIME2, uses FB branch for both local and GMT) and eventStartDatetimeGmt (line 325, DATETIMEOFFSET, uses COALESCE(EventStartDatetimeGmt, EventStartDatetime)). These are semantically different and the duplication is a potential source of confusion for callers.

codeSmells.issue: authorizedDeviceList and authorizedDeviceCount are always empty/zero
codeSmells.detail: The HasherKennelMap rowset hardcodes '' for authorizedDeviceList and 0 for authorizedDeviceCount (lines 221-223). These fields appear to be placeholders. Callers should not rely on them containing real data.

codeSmells.issue: isMember is a CASE expression returning INT not SMALLINT
codeSmells.detail: The isMember column (line 201) is produced by a CASE WHEN ... THEN 1 ELSE 0 END expression, which returns INT. The underlying HasherKennelMap.IsMember column is SMALLINT. Callers migrating from HC5 (which returned the stored SMALLINT column) should be aware of the type change and the semantic change (now computed rather than stored).

breakingChanges: isMember in HasherKennelMap rowset is now computed dynamically (CASE WHEN MembershipExpirationDate > GETDATE() THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) instead of returning the stored HasherKennelMap.IsMember SMALLINT column. The stored column can be stale; the computed value reflects current membership state. Column type changes from SMALLINT to INT.
@procName parameter widened from NVARCHAR(100) in HC5 to NVARCHAR(128) in HC6, matching OBJECT_NAME() return type.
